attribution: Zielak (mczielinski), Bitcoin Historical Data, Kaggle v706, normalized by ff137. Adapted to UTC sessions, simulated portfolios and sampled month-end marks.
inference_scope: Five retrospective annual folds. The 95% intervals apply to the base Sharpe difference and predictive difference at the five-minute execution proxy.
sampling: Last UTC close each month. Drawdown at that close uses the daily running peak. The maximum drawdown in the table uses all daily closes.
